require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'

module TenantIsolation
  TENANT_CACHE = {}
  
  def self.resolve_tenant(api_key)
    return TENANT_CACHE[api_key] if TENANT_CACHE.key?(api_key)
    tenant = Database.find_tenant_by_key(api_key)
    TENANT_CACHE[api_key] = tenant if tenant
    tenant
  end
  
  def self.invalidate(api_key)
    TENANT_CACHE.delete(api_key)
  end
end

module Database
  TENANTS = {}
  RESOURCES = {}
  
  def self.find_tenant_by_key(key)
    TENANTS.values.find { |t| BCrypt::Password.new(t[:key_hash]) == key rescue false }
  end
  
  def self.store_resource(tenant_id, resource_id, data)
    RESOURCES[tenant_id] ||= {}
    RESOURCES[tenant_id][resource_id] = data
  end
  
  def self.query_resources(tenant_id, filter_params)
    resources = RESOURCES[tenant_id] || {}
    apply_filters(resources, filter_params)
  end
  
  def self.apply_filters(resources, filter_params)
    result = resources.values
    
    if filter_params[:tags]
      requested_tags = parse_tag_expression(filter_params[:tags])
      result = result.select { |r| matches_tags?(r[:tags], requested_tags) }
    end
    
    if filter_params[:name_pattern]
      result = result.select { |r| matches_pattern?(r[:name], filter_params[:name_pattern]) }
    end
    
    result
  end
  
  def self.parse_tag_expression(expr)
    # Parse tag boolean expressions like "a AND (b OR c)"
    tokens = tokenize_tags(expr)
    build_tag_ast(tokens)
  end
  
  def self.tokenize_tags(expr)
    expr.scan(/[()\w]+|AND|OR|NOT/)
  end
  
  def self.build_tag_ast(tokens)
    # Returns nested structure for evaluation
    tokens.map { |t| t.match?(/^(AND|OR|NOT|[()])+$/) ? t.to_sym : t }
  end
  
  def self.matches_tags?(resource_tags, requested)
    return true if requested.nil? || requested.empty?
    resource_tags ||= []
    requested.any? { |t| t.is_a?(Symbol) || resource_tags.include?(t) }
  end
  
  def self.matches_pattern?(name, pattern)
    # Custom glob matching supporting * and ? wildcards
    # Convert to regex for matching
    regex_str = pattern.chars.map { |c|
      case c
      when '*' then '.*'
      when '?' then '.'
      when '.' then '\\.'
      else c
      end
    }.join
    Regexp.new("^#{regex_str}$").match?(name.to_s)
  end
end

class ResourceAPI < Sinatra::Base
  before do
    content_type :json
    @api_key = request.env['HTTP_X_API_KEY']
    halt 401, { error: 'Missing API key' }.to_json unless @api_key
    
    @tenant = TenantIsolation.resolve_tenant(@api_key)
    halt 403, { error: 'Invalid tenant' }.to_json unless @tenant
    @tenant_id = @tenant[:id]
  end
  
  post '/resources' do
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    halt 400, { error: 'Missing name' }.to_json unless payload[:name]
    
    resource_id = SecureRandom.uuid
    data = {
      id: resource_id,
      name: sanitize_name(payload[:name]),
      tags: Array(payload[:tags]).map(&:to_s).first(20),
      metadata: payload[:metadata].to_s.slice(0, 4096),
      created_at: Time.now.iso8601
    }
    
    Database.store_resource(@tenant_id, resource_id, data)
    status 201
    data.to_json
  end
  
  get '/resources' do
    filter_params = {}
    filter_params[:tags] = params[:tags] if params[:tags]
    filter_params[:name_pattern] = params[:name] if params[:name]
    
    results = Database.query_resources(@tenant_id, filter_params)
    { resources: results, count: results.length }.to_json
  end
  
  private
  
  def sanitize_name(name)
    name.to_s.gsub(/[^\w\s\-.]/, '').slice(0, 255)
  end
end

ResourceAPI.run! if __FILE__ == $0
